title: Christmas — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Christmas celebrates the birth of Jesus, observed on December 25 in Western churches and January 7 in many Eastern churches. It is among the most widely observed Christian festivals, blending worship with cultural traditions. This overview edition presents Christmas within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
